IC1: - Controlled intermittent asthma (step 1 treatment, according to GINA Guideline 2016) [AND] with or without association with cat allergy related rhino-conjunctivitis;
IC2: - Sensitization to cat allergen extract as defined by skin prick test for cat extract with a wheal diameter of ≥3 mm greater than negative control (ALK, HØrsholm, Denmark) and specific IgE anti Fel d 1 ≥ 0.7 kU/L ( ImmunoCAP, Thermofisher, Uppsala, Sweden);
IC4: - [NOT] No cat exposure at home [OR] or [NOT] outside of the home during the study;
IC5: - Positive methacholine challenge test performed using an AeroDoseur DTF-Atomisor ATO-AD 12 (Saint-Etienne, France);
IC6: - Early asthmatic response during baseline cat allergen exposure.
